method: Five alternating fresh runs per revision per case (confirmation series: ten), four-second traffic phase; default 4 pinned server workers (0-3 within mask 0-7), named one-worker/eight-worker series use 1/8 workers, 8 client workers (8-15); identical frozen inspection client. 1024 room readers, four-message fanout windows, 32 private pairs when enabled; 1 KiB values. No concurrent builds or benchmarks. Latency percentiles are histogram upper bounds; RSS is event-boundary process RSS, excluding kernel socket memory.
